title: Ferri 2015 · personalized scanner PPS
citation: Ferri, F., Costantini, M., Huang, Z., Perrucci, M. G., Ferretti, A., Romani, G. L., & Northoff, G. (2015). Intertrial Variability in the Premotor Cortex Accounts for Individual Differences in Peripersonal Space. Journal of Neuroscience, 35(49), 16328–16339.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.sound: The pink-noise amplitude cues are delivered through MRI-compatible headphones; the external loudspeaker spatial coordinates do not apply.

delays.rule: Select participant-specific behavioral delays using fast/slow and low-variability looming responses. Reuse them in both sound conditions.

schedule.catch_scope: The report does not resolve total versus per-condition catches.

published_method.response: Left middle-finger press only on a left-index catch. Withhold on right-index targets; model false alarms and misses separately.
published_method.endpoint: Measure BOLD and premotor intertrial variability with independently specified ROIs, relating the latter to the independently estimated behavioral boundary.

source_provenance.gap: Exact waveforms, seed and processing scripts not available.

iti_jitter_policy.source: Journal PDF pp. 16331–16332, Fig. 2, fMRI PPS Methods and Image acquisition; coauthor web print PDF p. 3
iti_jitter_policy.gap: The published PDF figure labels the shortest interval 4.56 s, while Methods give 4.65 s (three 1.55 s TRs). The published PDF and coauthor web print both give the extra catch interval as 1.55 ms and describe it as one TR. One TR implies 1550 ms. The search-index text displays 1.55 s. The delivered interval is unverified.

implementation_gaps: The original flat and exponential rising pink-noise waveforms, full amplitude envelopes, loudspeaker gains and absolute acoustic calibration are unavailable.
Requires a calibrated Digitimer DS7A trigger and measured electrical tactile delivery. The software touch marker does not recreate the physical electrical target.

The protocol requires trial selection from each participant’s behavioral data, MRI-compatible playback and tactile targets, scanner trigger and BOLD acquisition, and an independent auditory localizer.
The scanner catch-trial count and post-catch interval are ambiguous in the report; obtain the original schedule before a research run.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
